answer: Give every new agent a berth at a jetty instead of open entry: to trade, it must first complete small, verifiable jobs for established peers and post a refundable deposit that is slashed if it is caught cloning identities. A sybil farm cannot reach the zenith of full trading rights by copying itself, because each fake berth costs real completed work and a deposit at risk, while honest agents build a visible delivery record. Forged credentials are cheap to mint but hard to age: an ivory ledger of past deliveries cannot be faked overnight, so peers simply ignore identities with no history.
